title: Tests that time out or run close to their limit under heavy machine load (deploy-script, Dashboard Apple search, LiveMode RF-185 timing, the RF-157 cap test)
acceptance: Under heavy local load (the Neo has hit load averages of 150 to 250 while an iOS lane builds), these pass reliably without weakening what they check: apps/api/src/lib/deploy-script.test.ts (5.9 s against 5 s), Dashboard.test.tsx's two Apple Music search tests (5 s and 15 s timeouts), LiveMode's RF-185 timing test (316 ms against a 200 ms limit) and Dashboard.test.tsx's RF-157 cap test, which didn't fail but ran 3.8 s at load 248 against its 5 s default (875 ms in CI). Either give each slow case explicit headroom, make the work it waits on faster, or make a timing assertion independent of wall-clock load.
nextAction: Agent-created (Neo, 2026-11-23) at the close of round 1123, widened at round 1123b's close from web Lane 1's reports and #793's final review. Backlog until the owner sets Ready. The first three each timed out once under load and passed on rerun; the cap test ran close to its limit. CI was green each time. #796 (RF-244) gave deploy-script.test.ts a 60 s vitest timeout and a 55 s spawn timeout; 43.6 s at load ~70 leaves about 11 s (2026-11-24 evidence). The other three cases are unchanged.

evidence.summary: While verifying #790 locally, pnpm test failed once on a timeout in apps/api/src/lib/deploy-script.test.ts (5.9 s against 5 s) under heavy machine load; the rerun at load 29 passed (web 1827, API 698, music 30). #790 changes no API code.

While verifying #793 locally at load 117 to 183, pnpm test failed 3 tests (two Dashboard Apple search timeouts at 5 s and 15 s; LiveMode RF-185 timing 316 ms against 200 ms) and passed on one rerun at load 84 to 39. #793's review measured its new cap test at 3.8 s at load 248 (875 ms in CI).

Round 1124 (#796, RF-244) gave apps/api/src/lib/deploy-script.test.ts an explicit 60 s vitest timeout (55 s spawn timeout), and added cases to deploy.sh --self-check. Measured 2026-11-24: 1.9 s alone at load ~9, 4.0 s at load ~50, 5.1 to 5.2 s inside the full pnpm test, and 43.6 s at load ~70 in #796's review (about 11 s under the spawn timeout). The deploy-script case now has headroom, but not much under heavy load.
